plugins.name: dsh-hub-desktop-ui
plugins.description: Compact DSH front-end: sidebar status card, project and task-line integration, in-session group chat room, and a guided new-project dialog. Follows the DSH theme as-is.

plugins.name: dsh-project-room
plugins.description: Project rooms for DeepSeek Harness: group sessions into projects, see per-project runtime, and open a room with a shared board, task list, todo queue and message delivery to member sessions.

plugins.name: dsh-hub-callout
plugins.description: 把消息里的 GitHub admonition 语法（> [!NOTE] / > [!BOOK] 等）渲染成带彩色标题的提示块。

plugins.name: dsh-hub-quota-panel
plugins.description: 侧栏余额与用量面板：DeepSeek 账号余额 + 今日/本会话 token 用量（数据真实，失败显式提示）。

plugins.name: dsh-hub-reminders
plugins.description: DSH 会话 hook 注入：按白名单运行仓库 hooks/*.py，并把提醒文本注入每一轮（开工自检 / 测试清理 / 实事求是等）

plugins.name: dsh-hub-tool-policy
plugins.description: DSH 工具调用策略：拦截内联多行 Python、微信转发、来源标签等高风险写法

plugins.name: dsh-hub-curator
plugins.description: DSH 经验 curator：每 N 轮让 LLM 判定哪些经验值得沉淀（memory / skill / hook 三分类）

plugins.name: dsh-hub-branch
plugins.description: DSH 会话分支：branch-list / branch-fork / branch-pin / branch-merge 四个命令

plugins.name: dsh-hub-suite
plugins.description: AI-Agent-Hub 的 DSH 插件套装：一条命令装齐 project-room / hub-desktop-ui / callout / quota-panel / reminders / tool-policy / curator / branch（含依赖闭包）。其他插件包：dsh-hub-core、dsh-compact-tool 等由依赖自动带入。
